summary: iter-215 — Round-18 Security Audit fixes verified on preview (STRICTLY READ-ONLY, no NL/PANIC/activation/deploy-watch mutations). New HTTP suite tests/test_iter215_r18_audit.py = 6/6 pass. Backend integration suites re-run green: tests/integration/test_r18_audit.py 8 pass + 1 skip (replica-set-only), tests/integration/test_r17_audit.py 7 pass, tests/integration/test_r15_fenced_execution.py 16 pass — combined 31 passed / 1 skipped in 1.77s. HTTP checks: (a) GET /api/health → status=ok, ea_version='1.57'. (b) GET /api/status → overall='degraded', headline 'Platform controls available · trading degraded · connectivity idle', trading.readiness={state:'DEGRADED', dominant_code:'TERMINAL_STALE', decision_id:'dec_0df365cc8f4c', new_exposure_allowed:false}; 6 components enumerated (api, database, bot_engine, ea_bridge, payments, email). (c) GET /api/authority/decision (admin) → state='CLOSE_ONLY', dominant_code='POSITION_TRUTH_STALE', blockers=[POSITION_TRUTH_STALE, EA_CAPABILITY_BELOW_MIN, PERFORMANCE_UNRECONCILED, RECOVERY_WINDOW, TERMINAL_STALE]. (d) GET /api/accounts (admin) → 2 accounts: paper (ea_version=null, trading_enabled=true) + LIVE (ea_version='1.56', trading_enabled=true). Because the live account is below FENCING_MIN_EA=1.57 the authority decision correctly carries the EA_CAPABILITY_BELOW_MIN blocker — P0-02 canonical authority (trading_authority.infrastructure_domain → CLOSE_ONLY) verified end-to-end with real data. (e) GET /api/nl/triggers → 200 (empty list). (f) GET /api/ops/deploy-watch → 200, watch.status='cancelled' (see observation below). Frontend: public /status (no login) renders data-testid=status-overall with the backend headline, data-testid=status-trading-provenance with readiness DEGRADED · TERMINAL_STALE, connectivity idle, decision dec_f72bb691b4e5 · input v105, attestation 'not attested · platform_availability_only', new exposure refused, as-of timestamp; all 6 component rows present (status-{api,database,bot_engine,ea_bridge,payments,email}). /accounts (admin) renders the full app shell with the EA-version strip 'DOWNLOAD EA v1.57', the emergency banner shows blocker chips POSITION_TRUTH_STALE / EA_CAPABILITY_BELOW_MIN / PERFORMANCE_UNRECONCILED / RECOVERY_WINDOW (matching /api/authority/decision) and header line '2/2 ACC · 1/2 BOTS · 0/2 EA FRESH · 1 PAPER'; the 'Install the STOIC EA (v1.57+)' onboarding step is present. See flaky bundle note below for /admin/preflight.

integration_issues.flow: Admin /admin/preflight full-page load (also flaky on cold /status)
integration_issues.issue: Preview Vite dev server intermittently aborts lazy /src/*.jsx and /src/lib/*.js chunk requests with net::ERR_ABORTED (observed: /src/components/UnblockTour.jsx, /src/components/AccountSwitcher.jsx, /src/lib/tours.js). When this happens the app falls into the route-error-boundary ('STOIC IS TAKING LONGER THAN USUAL · component: frontend bundle · backend reachable') and preflight-check-* rows never render. /admin/preflight failed to load in 4 sequential retries this run; /status and /accounts eventually loaded after 1–2 retries. Not a Round-18 regression (no code path changed) but it prevents /admin/preflight smoke this iteration.

action_items: Investigate why /admin/preflight lazy chunks abort on the preview Vite server (dev bundle served via /src/*). Consider pre-bundling admin routes or shipping a production build to preview so route chunks are stable — this iteration could not smoke the mongo_transactions preflight row, signer-health-row, or deploy-watch-card in the UI (backend equivalents all verified via HTTP).

OBSERVATION (not raised as a bug): /api/ops/deploy-watch returned status='cancelled' at read time. The review request expected it to still be 'watching'. iter-215 tests did NOT cancel it (test asserts only that the value is one of the known states) and iter-214 report also did not touch the watch. If the deploy-watch should have remained 'watching', something outside this test lane cancelled it between iter-214 and iter-215. Per audit P2-02, watches older than 23h now become 'incident' (not re-sent); this row is 'cancelled' not 'incident', so it looks like an explicit cancel by an operator or an earlier E1 run rather than the age-out path.
critical_code_review_comments: P0-02 authority wiring is proven end-to-end on live data: the preview has an actual LIVE trading_enabled account on ea_version='1.56' and the /api/authority/decision blockers list surfaces EA_CAPABILITY_BELOW_MIN alongside POSITION_TRUTH_STALE / RECOVERY_WINDOW / TERMINAL_STALE — matching backend/ea_capabilities.py + trading_authority.infrastructure_domain going CLOSE_ONLY as designed. The state is CLOSE_ONLY, not TRADING_ENABLED, so no new exposure is allowed.

P0-01 close_seq durability + P1-01 transactions_required + P1-02 PANIC ops_outbox invariants are covered by the integration suite (31 passed / 1 replica-set-only skipped). Standalone-Mongo skip is the expected shape for preview; replica-set-only test is annotated to skip locally.

The public /status trading-provenance block renders every field required by the P2-03 audit (readiness state · dominant_code, connectivity, decision id + input version, attestation state, new-exposure refused, as-of timestamp) with graceful fallbacks. Correct backend headline is preferred over the component-derived fallback.

Preview frontend still serves via Vite dev server (chunk URLs under /src/*). This works but chunks abort intermittently through the ingress and drop admin routes into the route-error-boundary. Not a Round-18 issue — flag for the deploy/lib.sh admission story: shipping a production build to preview would remove this class of flake.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (public /status + /accounts admin verified; /admin/preflight not verified this run — dev-server chunk abort in preview)

seed_data_creation: None. No NL mutation, no PANIC, no activation flip, no deploy-watch cancel by this test run. Read-only guarantee (audit P0-02) upheld.

rca of the issue: No Round-18 bugs found. All P0/P1/P2 changes behave per spec on preview: (1) authority decision surfaces EA_CAPABILITY_BELOW_MIN for the live account still on EA 1.56, (2) the /api/health ea_version advertises the new minimum '1.57', (3) fenced execution + transactions_required + PANIC outbox invariants covered green in the integration lane, and (4) the read-only regressions (nl/triggers, deploy-watch, public /status) all return 200 with the expected shape. Only environmental flake: preview dev-server chunk aborts prevented /admin/preflight UI verification this run — backend equivalents (deploy-preflight, deploy-watch, authority-decision) all verified via HTTP.
